title: Poker Knight NG v1 equity result
description: Successful, complete deterministic Texas Hold'em equity-solve result only.
$comment: This schema represents success only: failures use problem.schema.json and MUST NOT include partial counters. Wire JSON is not ADR 0003 canonical case serialization. Semantic validation is normative: completed_trials == requested_trials; ties == sum(tie_by_other_winners); unique_wins + ties + losses == completed_trials; bins greater than opponent_count are zero; category counters sum to completed_trials; equity_share_units == 420*unique_wins + sum((420/(k+1))*bin[k]); probability fractions MUST be represented exactly and unreduced as unique_win={unique_wins, completed_trials}, tie={ties, completed_trials}, loss={losses, completed_trials}, showdown_equity={equity_share_units, 420*completed_trials}; and no merely equivalent reduced representation is accepted. Violations map to INTERNAL_ERROR (or RNG_REJECTION_EXHAUSTED if applicable) and no success result is returned. Provenance identifier regexes are generated/centralized definitions and MUST have committed generator/conformance tests in Phase 1.

contract_version.description: Result contract version. Provenance: copied from accepted v1 request. Planned test: const validation.

backend.description: Backend that actually executed; equals requested backend because fallback is forbidden. Planned test: enum validation and request/result coherence.

rng.description: ADR 0003 sampler identity used for this result. Planned test: exact identity.

algorithm_version.description: Canonical decimal version token, parsed to the internal version integer only after schema validation.

case_hash.description: Lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256 of ADR 0003 canonical case bytes, excluding seed and trials. Provenance: canonicalizer. Planned test: exact format and recomputation.

seed.description: Explicit replay seed encoded identically to request. Provenance: accepted request. Planned test: canonical seed format.

requested_trials.description: Canonical decimal requested trial count. Provenance: accepted request. Planned test: decimal uint64 form and equality with completed_trials.

completed_trials.description: Canonical decimal trials completed. Successful v1 result equals requested_trials exactly. Provenance: final integer reduction. Planned test: semantic equality.

unique_wins.description: Hero-only maximum-rank event count. Units: trials. Provenance: integer reduction. Planned test: outcome partition.

ties.description: Aggregate hero tie-event count. Units: trials. Provenance: integer reduction; equals sum(tie_by_other_winners). Planned test: aggregate tie-bin accounting and outcome partition.

tie_by_other_winners.description: Exact hero tie-event bins by number k of equal-key opponent co-winners. Units: trials. Provenance: integer reduction. Planned test: fixed bins, partition, and zero impossible bins.

1.description: Count of ties with exactly 1 other winner(s); units: trials; provenance: integer reduction; planned test: tie-bin accounting.

2.description: Count of ties with exactly 2 other winner(s); units: trials; provenance: integer reduction; planned test: tie-bin accounting.

3.description: Count of ties with exactly 3 other winner(s); units: trials; provenance: integer reduction; planned test: tie-bin accounting.

4.description: Count of ties with exactly 4 other winner(s); units: trials; provenance: integer reduction; planned test: tie-bin accounting.

5.description: Count of ties with exactly 5 other winner(s); units: trials; provenance: integer reduction; planned test: tie-bin accounting.

6.description: Count of ties with exactly 6 other winner(s); units: trials; provenance: integer reduction; planned test: tie-bin accounting.

losses.description: Hero loss events with an opponent strictly higher. Units: trials. Provenance: integer reduction. Planned test: outcome partition.

equity_share_units.description: Exact accumulated hero pot-share units with denominator 420 per trial. Provenance: integer reduction. Planned test: ADR 0002 tie formula.

hero_category_counts.description: Exactly one final seven-card hero category increment per completed trial. Units: trials. Provenance: evaluator then integer reduction. Planned test: nine-category partition and no royal_flush bucket.

high_card.description: Hero final high_card count; units: trials; provenance: evaluator/reduction; planned test: category partition.

one_pair.description: Hero final one_pair count; units: trials; provenance: evaluator/reduction; planned test: category partition.

two_pair.description: Hero final two_pair count; units: trials; provenance: evaluator/reduction; planned test: category partition.

three_of_a_kind.description: Hero final three_of_a_kind count; units: trials; provenance: evaluator/reduction; planned test: category partition.

straight.description: Hero final straight count; units: trials; provenance: evaluator/reduction; planned test: category partition.

flush.description: Hero final flush count; units: trials; provenance: evaluator/reduction; planned test: category partition.

full_house.description: Hero final full_house count; units: trials; provenance: evaluator/reduction; planned test: category partition.

four_of_a_kind.description: Hero final four_of_a_kind count; units: trials; provenance: evaluator/reduction; planned test: category partition.

straight_flush.description: Hero final straight_flush count; units: trials; provenance: evaluator/reduction; planned test: category partition.

probabilities.description: Host-derived exact rational quantities, never GPU floating accumulators. Each numerator/denominator representation is frozen by normative semantic validation and is not merely an equivalent ratio. Provenance: exact counters and denominator 420. Planned test: recomputation from counters.

unique_win.description: Exact unreduced fraction {unique_wins, completed_trials}; unitless event probability; host-derived; planned recomputation test.

tie.description: Exact unreduced fraction {ties, completed_trials}; unitless event probability; host-derived; planned recomputation test.

loss.description: Exact unreduced fraction {losses, completed_trials}; unitless event probability; host-derived; planned recomputation test.

showdown_equity.description: Exact unreduced fraction {equity_share_units, 420*completed_trials}; unitless pot-share probability; host-derived; planned recomputation test.

timing.description: Measured end-to-end solve duration; timing is operational evidence, not a stable kernel-internal performance API. Uses host monotonic elapsed nanoseconds with exact portable uint64 representation.

total_duration_ns.description: End-to-end solve elapsed nanoseconds, including validation/execution/host derivation as implemented. Units: ns. Provenance: host monotonic clock. Planned test: exact canonical uint64 string.

provenance.description: Execution provenance. No fallback, multi-GPU, streaming, or advanced-analytics metadata exists in v1. Planned test: required identifiers and CPU null device/kernel.

engine_build_id.description: Immutable log-safe printable ASCII engine build/revision identifier. Provenance: build system. Planned test: safe printable ASCII identifier, bounds, and log-injection rejection.

backend_qualification.description: Log-safe printable ASCII qualification identifier/status for actual backend. Provenance: deployment qualification record. Planned test: safe printable ASCII identifier, bounds, and log-injection rejection.

device_id.description: Log-safe printable ASCII qualified CUDA device identifier, or null for cpu_reference. Provenance: runtime device discovery. Planned test: safe identifier and backend semantic coherence.

kernel_id.description: Log-safe printable ASCII CUDA kernel/source build identifier, or null for cpu_reference. Provenance: CUDA build. Planned test: safe identifier and backend semantic coherence.

provenanceIdentifier128.description: Log-safe printable ASCII provenance identifier of 1..128 characters; starts alphanumeric and permits only common build/device identifier punctuation. Planned test: representative IDs, bounds, and injection rejection.

provenanceIdentifier256.description: Log-safe printable ASCII provenance identifier of 1..256 characters; starts alphanumeric and permits only common build/device identifier punctuation. Planned test: representative IDs, bounds, and injection rejection.

uint64.description: Canonical decimal unsigned-64-bit integer string in the inclusive range 0..18446744073709551615; no leading zeroes except 0. Planned test: rejects numeric JSON, leading zeroes, and out-of-range values.

trialCount.description: Canonical decimal requested-trial count in the inclusive range 1..43920819223117980; no leading zeroes. Planned test: exact request/result trial bound.
trialCount.$comment: Generated from the one authoritative numeric bound floor((2^64-1)/420); request and result trialCount patterns MUST remain byte-identical. The temporary conformance harness proves equality.

probabilityFraction.description: Closed exact rational representation using canonical decimal uint64 strings. denominator is strictly positive. Schema permits unreduced ratios; result semantic validation freezes each named numerator and denominator representation exactly.
